text_markup: If a drawn card is swapped with another card, the card swapped into the set-aside zone is now considered "drawn", can be manipulated by other abilities, and will be added to the hand with the other drawn cards.
text_plain: If a drawn card is swapped with another card, the card swapped into the set-aside zone is now considered "drawn", can be manipulated by other abilities, and will be added to the hand with the other drawn cards.

examples.text_markup: The Corp takes their mandatory draw while they have {card:Daily Business Show} and {card:Raman Rai} rezzed. They set aside {card:Wraparound} and {card:Enigma} from the top of R&D. After looking at those cards and the cards in Archives, the Corp uses {card:Raman Rai} to reveal the {card:Enigma} and a {card:Tollbooth} from Archives and swap them. Then, the corp uses {card:Daily Business Show} to add {card:Tollbooth} to the bottom of the deck. Finally, the Corp adds {card:Wraparound} to HQ.
